app.name: Kvita
app.headline: All settled. Every month.
app.lead: Rent, bills and messages between landlord and tenant in one place.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.emailHint: No password needed. We'll send you a 6-digit code.
auth.codeValidity: The code is valid for 10 minutes. Only the latest code works.
auth.resendIn: You can request a new code in {{seconds}} s
auth.devHint: Development: the code is in the server terminal, in the latest “E-mail za {{email}}” block.

onboarding.title: What brings you to Kvita?
onboarding.subtitle: Pick where you start. You can add the other role any time.
onboarding.landlordHint: Post rent and bills, confirm payments and talk to your tenants.
onboarding.tenantHint: See what to pay and by when, report payments and message your landlord.

addRole.LANDLORD: I also rent out a property

home.landlordIntro: Set up your rental in three steps.

landlordSteps.property: Add a property and its units
landlordSteps.propertyHint: The address and the flats you rent out.
landlordSteps.tenancyHint: Rent, payment day, deposit and your IBAN.
landlordSteps.inviteHint: Send a link or show a QR code. No app install needed.

home.comingSoon: These steps arrive in the next Kvita update.
home.tenantBody: Send your landlord your e-mail so they can invite you. Once you accept, rent, bills and messages show up here.

install.iosTitle: Add Kvita to your Home Screen
install.iosBody: It's the only way your iPhone can send you reminders. In Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.updateAvailable: A new version of Kvita is available.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be outdated or mistyped.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check what you entered. Something is missing or in the wrong format.
errors.OTP_INVALID: The code doesn't match or has expired. Make sure you enter the latest code.
errors.OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong attempts. Request a new code.
errors.OTP_RATE_LIMITED: We've already sent 5 codes to this e-mail in the last hour. Enter the latest one or try again in an hour.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests at once. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found, or you don't have access.
errors.PROPERTY_HAS_ACTIVE_TENANCY: The property has an active tenancy. End it first.
errors.UNIT_HAS_ACTIVE_TENANCY: The unit already has an active tenancy.
errors.TENANCY_HAS_CHARGES: The tenancy has charges, so it can't be deleted. You can end it.
errors.INVITE_ACCEPTED: The invitation has already been accepted.
errors.INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: The invitation is for a different e-mail.
errors.INVITE_OWN_PROPERTY: You can't accept your own invitation as a tenant.

validation.amount: Enter an amount, for example 650 or 650.50.
validation.dueDay: Enter a day of the month from 1 to 31.
validation.INVALID_IBAN: The IBAN is not valid. Check the digits.
validation.END_BEFORE_START: The end must be after the start.

properties.newSubtitle: The house or building you rent out. You'll add flats in the next step.
properties.name: Name
properties.nameHint: What you call it, e.g. “Building in Vič”.
properties.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}” with all its empty units?

units.title: Units
units.emptyBody: Add a flat or room you rent out.
units.name: Unit name
units.nameHint: For example “Flat 3” or “Room by the bathroom”.

tenancies.newSubtitle: Enter the terms once. Kvita prepares the rent from them every month.
tenancies.endHint: Leave empty for an open-ended tenancy.
tenancies.payeeHint: These details go on the UPN payment order your tenant receives.
tenancies.costsHint: Pick what you agreed on. Kvita assumes nothing.

splitHint.PERCENTAGE: You set a percentage for each tenant.
splitHint.PER_PERSON: The share depends on how many people each tenant represents.

tenancies.sharesMustTotal: Shares add up to {{total}} %. They must add up to 100 %.
tenancies.noTenantsBody: Send an invitation. Once accepted, they show up here.
tenancies.confirmEnd: End the tenancy? No new rent will be created.

invite.title: Invite a tenant
invite.intro: Create a link and send it to your tenant, or show the QR code. They don't need to install an app.
invite.emailHint: Optional. If you enter it, we e-mail the invitation and only that address can accept it.
invite.sent: We sent the invitation to {{email}}. You can also show or copy it.
invite.showOrSend: Your tenant scans the code with the phone camera or opens the link.
invite.onceNote: You only see this link now. If you lose it, create a new one.

acceptInvite.title: Join the tenancy on Kvita
acceptInvite.noApp: No app needed. Everything works in the browser.
acceptInvite.emailMismatch: This invitation is for {{email}}. Sign in with that address.
acceptInvite.notFoundBody: The link may be mistyped. Ask your landlord for a new one.
acceptInvite.askNew: Ask your landlord to send you a new invitation.

state.ACCEPTED: This invitation has already been accepted
